'''''Lambda-11238''''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] which landed at [[Landing Bay Besh]], in [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], while a band of fugitives infiltrated the [[Mos Shuuta landing control|control center]] in an attempt to release the [[Docking clamp/Legends|docking clamps]] on the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Krayt Fang]]''.
